C1853.title: UN Libya Panel Report Disclosed KARGU-2 Autonomous Drone Combat Incident
keywords: UN Libya Panel Report Disclosed KARGU-2 Autonomous Drone Combat Incident
C1853.summary: In March 2021, the UN Security Council Panel of Experts on Libya reported that in March 2020, retreating logistics convoys affiliated with Haftar's forces were hunted by KARGU-2 and other loitering munition systems capable of autonomous operation. The systems were described as having target-tracking capabilities and not requiring an ongoing operator link, prompting debate over autonomous drone coordination and control boundaries.

references.title: UN Security Council: Final report of the Panel of Experts on Libya established pursuant to resolution 1973 (2011) - S/2021/229
